sth.text: In Stronghold, Belbe is forced by Crovax's coup to name him evincar, and Crovax then defeats Volrath in a duel thanks to Ertai.
Eladamri kills Belbe and flees to Dominaria, leaving Ertai to submit to Crovax.

nem.text: In Nemesis, Abcal-dro has Avila murdered and reconstructs her body as the cyborg Belbe, implanting the Eye of Yawgmoth, and she is sent to oversee the contest to choose the next evincar.
Belbe grows disillusioned with Phyrexia, disables the Eye of Yawgmoth, falls in love with Ertai, and begins a plan to cut flowstone production to prevent the Rathi Overlay.

Crovax organizes a coup and forces her to crown him evincar, and at the Dream Halls Belbe learns her origins and reprograms her portal so that Eladamri, Takara en-Dal and Lin Sivvi escape to Dominaria.
Eladamri, seeing his dead daughter's face, throws the last of Avila's poison on Belbe, killing her instantly, and Crovax holds a funeral for her.
